description: This file contains serialization and copying logic for ReadOnlyCollection<T> in Orleans, including surrogate types, codecs, and deep copiers.

classes.name: ReadOnlyCollectionSurrogate<T>
classes.description: A surrogate representation for ReadOnlyCollection<T> used during serialization.

classes.name: ReadOnlyCollectionCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer class responsible for converting ReadOnlyCollection<T> to and from its surrogate.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate into a ReadOnlyCollection<T> instance.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a ReadOnlyCollection<T> into its surrogate representation.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the ReadOnlyCollection<T> instance.
